definitions.explanation: An argument or outlook holding that a situation will turn out badly. Used of a stated position in debate — on the economy, the environment, a company's prospects — rather than of a person's temperament.

examples.japanese: {悲観論|ひかんろん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{悲観論|ひかんろん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: Pessimism about the economy is strong.

examples.japanese: {悲観論|ひかんろん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{傾|かたむ}く→傾く：00200_katamuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{変|か}わらない→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: It is easy to lean toward pessimism, but nothing changes that way.

notes:
⟦{悲観|ひかん}→悲観：22397_hikan⟧ (pessimism) + ⟦{論|ろん}→〜論：04017_ron⟧ (argument, theory). The 〜⟦{論|ろん}→〜論：04017_ron⟧ ending makes it a position that can be held, stated, and argued against.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悲観論|ひかんろん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}まる→強まる：02295_tsuyomaru⟧: for pessimism to grow stronger
- {悲観論|ひかんろん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{傾|かたむ}く→傾く：00200_katamuku⟧: to lean toward pessimism
- {悲観論|ひかんろん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{唱|とな}える→唱える：10467_tonaeru⟧: to argue a pessimistic case
- ⟦{根強|ねづよ}い→根強い：13106_nezuyoi⟧{悲観論|ひかんろん}: deep-rooted pessimism

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{悲観的|ひかんてき}→悲観的：06091_hikanteki⟧: pessimistic — the adjective, describing a person or an outlook
- ⟦{楽観論|らっかんろん}→楽観論：30517_rakkanron⟧: optimistic view — the direct opposite
